dedupe_keys.name: road deposited sediment wash off experiments on a large scale laboratory

description: Zafra Mejía, Carlos Alfonso at Universidad Distrital Francisco José de Caldas publishes paired hydraulic, sediment and chemical observations from large-scale roadway wash-off tests through Co-UDlabs. Two rainfall intensities(30/50 mm/h) and three sediment loads(100/150/200 g/m²) define the campaign. This deposit supplies maps, flows, surface velocities and solids balances; companion 14656653 supplies heavy-metal/carbon analyses at the same road, gully and manhole components. Coverage is the UDC BLOCK physical street facility in Spain; experiment dates are unspecified. Zenodo provides hydraulic-test ZIP archives, descriptive documents and companion chemical XLSX files with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the two deposits share campaign conditions and may overlap, so they form one bundle; they are not independent experimental populations. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
